purpose: Seed sources for taste-first link packs. These are starting points, not fixed rules.

lookbook_images.name: Vogue Runway - Menswear
lookbook_images.why: Reliable runway/lookbook image archive with designer context.

lookbook_images.name: Vogue Runway - Lemaire
lookbook_images.why: Quiet uniform, relaxed tailoring, understated styling. Runway archive with full lookbook images.

lookbook_images.name: 032c Magazine
lookbook_images.why: Fashion plus culture, useful for stronger attitude and article references.

lookbook_images.name: Hypebeast Fashion
lookbook_images.why: Lookbook and streetwear drops; needs strict taste filtering.

lookbook_images.name: Highsnobiety Style
lookbook_images.why: Trend and editorial style links; useful but should avoid generic influencer pieces.

lookbook_images.name: BranD Magazine
lookbook_images.why: Hong Kong bilingual design magazine. Strong editorial curation on branding, typography, objects, visual culture. Uses HTTP (no SSL) — web scraper only.

lookbook_images.name: Das Programm — Dieter Rams Archive
lookbook_images.why: Comprehensive Dieter Rams archive: Braun electronics 1955–1995 and Vitsoe furniture. Product images are small (~300px) — uses lowered dimension threshold.

lookbook_images.name: Toshio Saeki — WikiArt Archive
lookbook_images.why: 17 artworks on WikiArt. Japanese ero-guro illustrator (1945–2019). Surreal, dark, traditionally-rooted but modern.

lookbook_images.name: Toshio Saeki Estate
lookbook_images.why: Official estate site. Mostly text/about — primary image source is WikiArt above.

lookbook_images.name: Savee — Curated Design
lookbook_images.why: 1M+ creatives, ad-free, human-curated design inspiration. No algorithm. Strong editorial/archival aesthetic. Good for quiet, refined visual references.

lookbook_images.name: Same Energy — Visual Search
lookbook_images.why: Visual search engine that finds images by 'energy' rather than keywords. Useful for discovering visually-similar references across unexpected domains.

lookbook_images.name: Visuelle — Branding & Editorial
lookbook_images.why: Curated branding, packaging, and editorial projects. Clean, refined, commercial-but-not-generic visual language.

videos.name: SHOWstudio Fashion Film
videos.why: Fashion film archive and submissions, better for wild visual references.

videos.name: SHOWstudio Video
videos.why: Experimental fashion moving image and process references.

videos.name: Dazed Video
videos.why: Youth culture, art, music, fashion video references.

videos.name: Vimeo Staff Picks
videos.why: Useful for cinematic, unusual video language outside fashion.

videos.name: Rams — Gary Hustwit
videos.why: Documentary on Dieter Rams. Design philosophy, object culture, 'less, but better'. Feeds the quiet, functional, timeless taste direction with visual and conceptual depth.

articles.name: SSENSE Editorial
articles.why: Culture and fashion essays with stronger point of view.

articles.name: 032c Magazine
articles.why: Deep fashion/culture interviews and theory-adjacent pieces.

articles.name: Dazed Fashion
articles.why: Fashion culture with attitude; good for article angles.

articles.name: The Guardian Art & Design
articles.why: Architecture/design/culture depth that can feed lifestyle positioning.

articles.name: Vogue Business
articles.why: Fashion industry context, useful for deeper posts and captions.

articles.name: BranD Magazine
articles.why: Bilingual design culture and branding thinking. Uses HTTP. Translates visual taste into conceptual frameworks.

articles.name: Vitsoe — Dieter Rams Philosophy
articles.why: Dieter Rams' Ten Principles of Good Design. Foundation-level taste text: 'less, but better', 'good design is as little design as possible'. Aligns with quiet editorial tone.

articles.name: Toshio Saeki — Selected Works & Essays
articles.why: Deep archive of Saeki's illustrated works 1972–2016 with critical context. Erotic-grotesque tradition meets modern surrealism — useful for understanding visual provocation with restraint.

articles.name: STEEP — Cultural Intelligence
articles.why: Culture and trend intelligence platform. Curated signals across design, fashion, tech, food. Feeds editorial angle without lifestyle-blog fluff.

articles.name: SiteInspire — Editorial Web Design
articles.why: Curated editorial and minimal web design. Useful for layout, typography, white space, and grid composition references. Clean, not trendy.

architecture_interiors.name: Dezeen
architecture_interiors.why: Global architecture and design, minimalist interiors

architecture_interiors.name: Leibal
architecture_interiors.why: Minimalist architecture and interior design blog

architecture_interiors.name: Divisare
architecture_interiors.why: Atlas of architecture, very editorial photography

japanese_korean_aesthetics.name: OK Fred
japanese_korean_aesthetics.why: Japanese brand lookbooks and editorial curation

japanese_korean_aesthetics.name: Mastered Japan
japanese_korean_aesthetics.why: Japanese fashion editorial and brand archives

archive_reference.name: Wikimedia Commons Fashion
archive_reference.why: Public domain fashion images and archives

street_photography.name: TokyoFashion
street_photography.why: Tokyo street fashion, raw and unfiltered

street_photography.name: Style Du Monde
street_photography.why: Street style photography from fashion weeks

product_object_design.name: Muji Advisory
product_object_design.why: MUJI aesthetic reference for taste objects

product_object_design.name: Yanko Design
product_object_design.why: Modern industrial design and product concepts

trending_social.name: Are.na
trending_social.why: Visual discovery community — channels like 'menswear', 'streetwear', 'editorial moodboards'. Curated, slow, no algorithm. Replaces blocked Reddit for visual community research.

trending_social.name: Zhihu — Streetstyle / Fashion Questions
trending_social.why: Chinese Q&A community (Reddit-equivalent). Long-form discussions on street style, brand history, design philosophy. Useful for taste-trend narrative sourcing in 中文.

trending_social.name: Bilibili — Fashion Documentary Channels
trending_social.why: Chinese video community. Long-form fashion documentaries, brand retrospectives, archive footage. Replaces blocked TikTok for fast visual trend sampling.

trending_social.name: Xiaohongshu (小红书) — Fashion Notes
trending_social.why: Chinese social commerce. Real-user outfit posts, capsule wardrobe builds, NOIR/minimalist/lemaire aesthetic moodboards. Strong source for 真实穿搭 references.

trending_social.name: Weibo — Hypebeast China
trending_social.why: Chinese social feed. Real-time 潮流 drop news, celebrity street style, designer reactions. Filtered accounts (Hypebeast China, NOWRE official) yield curated visual feed.

trending_social.name: Voice of Fashion
trending_social.why: India's leading independent fashion-culture magazine. Newsletter + articles. Strong on craft, material, archive references — closer to 032c tone than Hypebeast.

trending_social.name: FUDGE Japan
trending_social.why: Tokyo-based editorial magazine. London / Paris street style captures, menswear, neutral palette. Strongly matches the quiet/JJJJound-adjacent mood.

trending_social.name: InsideHook
trending_social.why: Daily men's lifestyle newsletter. Editorial taste filter on restaurants, fashion, gear, travel. Useful for curated taste references outside the hype cycle.

trending_social.name: Highsnobiety — Sneakers
trending_social.why: Sneaker-specific vertical of Highsnobiety. Strong on JJJJound / New Balance / Salomon / vintage runner drops. Editorial taste filter avoids generic hype.

trending_social.name: AnOther Magazine
trending_social.why: Dazed's high-fashion sibling. Editorial, art, photography, gender-fluid styling. Useful for stronger conceptual references and portraiture.

trending_social.name: 10 Magazine
trending_social.why: Independent print/digital fashion magazine. Strong on emerging womenswear, designer interviews, runway. Art direction skews minimal/refined.

trending_social.name: System Magazine
trending_social.why: Bi-annual print magazine, strong on fashion-system analysis, designer interviews, set design. Quiet, intellectual, no banner-feed energy.

trending_social.name: Print Magazine
trending_social.why: Design / typography / visual culture. Editorial sources on editorial design, packaging, and brand systems. Useful for graphic / print references.

trending_social.name: Fashion Beans
trending_social.why: Men's style how-to + trend reporting. Useful for spot-checking mainstream taste baselines (what's 'normal' vs what's quiet/refined).

trending_social.name: Are.na Blog
trending_social.why: Are.na's editorial blog — designer interviews, channel deep dives, community sparks. Strong visual / research angle for moodboard taste.

trending_social.name: Popbee
trending_social.why: Hong Kong / pan-Asian fashion + lifestyle outlet. Editorial street style, designer coverage, K-pop / C-pop outfit breakdowns. Bilingual mix.

trending_social.name: Mensuno HK
trending_social.why: Hong Kong men's style magazine. Asian streetwear, watches, grooming, lifestyle. Useful for HK/JP menswear cross-references.

trending_social.name: NOWRE
trending_social.why: Leading 中文 fashion潮流 media. Covers 国潮 / 日潮 / 美潮, designer drops, brand culture. Long-form than Hypebeast China, more editorial.

trending_social.name: Hypebeast China
trending_social.why: 中文 Hypebeast edition. 高频 drop news, sneaker intel, designer interviews. Use taste filter — dedupe against Hypebeast.com.

trending_social.name: GQ China
trending_social.why: Chinese edition of GQ. Long-form 时尚 / 文化 / 生活方式 features. Strong editorial photography and Chinese celebrity styling for cross-reference.

trending_social.name: GQ Taiwan
trending_social.why: Taiwan GQ. Editorially distinct from China edition — strong on JP/TW menswear, design, food culture. Useful Asian menswear cross-reference.

trending_social.name: Hypebae
trending_social.why: Hypebeast's womenswear / youth-culture sibling. Strong on streetwear, beauty, art, gender-fluid editorial. Editorial filter keeps it from the influencer-feed.

trending_social.name: NYLON Magazine
trending_social.why: Pop-culture + fashion + music magazine. New York / London editorial lens. Useful for youth-culture / scene references and emerging designer features.

trending_social.name: Paper Magazine
trending_social.why: Independent print+digital magazine. Art, fashion, music, pop culture. Strong on avant-garde editorial photography and underground scene coverage.

trending_social.name: It's Nice That
trending_social.why: Independent design / art / visual culture publication. Strong on emerging designers, illustration, photography, editorial design. Quiet / refined visual baseline.

trending_social.name: Japanese Fashion Archive
trending_social.why: Archive of Japanese avant-garde designers (Comme, Yohji, Issey, Kansai, Christopher Nemeth). Useful for archive / piece-history references.

trending_social.name: Complex
trending_social.why: Pop culture + streetwear + sneaker outlet. Strong on streetwear history, drops, cultural commentary. Use taste filter to skip hype-only content.

trending_social.name: Sneaker Freaker
trending_social.why: Independent print sneaker magazine. Long-form shoe culture history, designer interviews (incl. JJJJound), vintage runner references.

trending_social.name: End Clothing — Journal
trending_social.why: Premium menswear retailer with strong editorial 'Journal' section. Brand stories, designer interviews, lookbook editorial. Quiet luxury / streetwear crossover.

trending_social.name: Dover Street Market
trending_social.why: Comme des Garçons multi-brand concept store. Editorial product pages, seasonal capsules, designer collaborations. Strongest single feed for avant-garde streetwear.

trending_social.name: Sneakersnstuff
trending_social.why: Stockholm sneaker boutique with strong editorial (news, interviews). Nordic taste filter — quieter than most US sneaker feeds.

trending_social.name: Matchesfashion
trending_social.why: Luxury / contemporary retailer with editorial 'The Journal'. Designer interviews, mood-driven lookbooks, travel features. Useful for elevated menswear references.

trending_social.name: Gentle Monster
trending_social.why: Korean eyewear brand with strong editorial / campaign aesthetic. Avant-garde visual identity, K-fashion references, conceptual store design.

trending_social.name: Acne Studios
trending_social.why: Stockholm design brand. Editorial lookbooks, seasonal typographic / photographic identity. Strong reference for quiet / Nordic / minimalist taste.

trending_social.name: Dezeen
trending_social.why: Leading architecture / design magazine. Useful for design-week coverage, retail interiors, brand visual-system references, and crossover design/fashion.

trending_social.name: Designboom
trending_social.why: Independent design magazine. Strong on emerging designers, industrial design, fashion-design crossover. Editorial taste filter on global design-week coverage.

trending_social.name: Smooth Magazine
trending_social.why: Independent fashion & culture magazine. Visual-led, strong on emerging designers and editorial photography. Quiet-channel alternative to Hypebae.

trending_social.name: Numero Tokyo
trending_social.why: Japanese edition of Numero. Strong editorial photography, fashion-editorial + JP street style + art direction. Concept-led issues.

trending_social.name: W Magazine
trending_social.why: High-fashion American magazine. Editorial-grade celebrity / fashion editorials, designer features. Visual quality baseline for editorial references.
